topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: You ever think life circles back on you like a boomerang you never wanted to see again? I’m staring at an old yearbook, pictures of faces I can’t forget, one of them now teaching my kid. Memories I don’t want dredged up, surfacing like a corpse in a pond. I need to talk to my kid, see if they’ve noticed, if they’ve said anything. Maybe it’s nothing, but I’ve been down this road before, and nothing’s ever just nothing. Got to keep a close eye, ask the right questions, make sure history doesn’t repeat itself. Not on my watch.
